thread:
Alex W: Hey folks — PR #8421 is blocked by CI. windows-e2e failed on two tests: integrations/session-timeout and integrations/auth-refresh. Small change to sharder allocation. Can someone take a quick look? CI: https://buildkite.com/redwood/pr-8421/windows-e2e#24
CI Bot: buildkite — pr-8421/windows-e2e #24 — failed. Failing tests: integrations/session-timeout, integrations/auth-refresh. Log snippet:
```ERROR: Timeout while waiting for session restore (120s)
  File "tests/integrations/test_session.py", line 87, in test_session_restore
```
Priya S: On it — I'll try to repro on my Windows VM. My hunch is infra / agent load.
Jorge M: Those two have been noisy lately. @Lina (QA) can you eyeball the logs and see if this looks related to Alex's change?
Lina (QA): Looking now. The stack shows the session restore waiting on an external call. Can you paste the exact test command + env?
Alex W: Command: `pytest tests/integrations/test_session.py::test_session_restore -q`
Env: WINDOWS_RUN=1, SHARDER_THREADS=4
Also saw `sysinfo: high load` in agent logs around the failure.
Priya S: If agent was overloaded, a clean worker should pass. I'll requeue the windows-e2e job.
Priya S: /rebuild windows-e2e (triggering a rebuild on Buildkite)
CI Bot: Rebuild triggered: buildkite.com/redwood/pr-8421/windows-e2e #25 — queued
Jorge M: If it flakes again we should bisect by reverting the sharder change — but if it's infra, rerun and merge on green + 1 approval is fine.
Lina (QA): There's also a timing assertion that uses 100ms sleeps. I'd rather not change tests without reproducing locally. If it repros we can make the timing less brittle.
Alex W: I can add a micro-fix to remove the strict timing if we reproduce. For now, can someone promise to give approval after green? @Priya @Jorge
Priya S: I'll review artifacts after green and approve if everything looks sane. Ping me when #25 finishes.
CI Bot: buildkite — pr-8421/windows-e2e #25 — passed ✅
Priya S: Artifacts and logs look clean. Approving now. :white_check_mark:
Jorge M: Approved.
Alex W: Merging on green. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :tada:
CI Bot: pr-8421 — merged by Alex W (commit abc123)
Alex W: Filed follow-up ticket INT-512 to make that test less timing-sensitive. Thanks again!
